testing.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

buttons.primary_gold: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] transition-all duration-300
buttons.ai_action: bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/20 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full px-8 py-4 flex items-center gap-3 hover:bg-white/20 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)] transition-all duration-300

layout_sections.name: Navigation & Header
layout_sections.layout: Fixed top, z-50, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0a0a]/70 border-b border-white/10).
layout_sections.content: Salon Logo (Playfair), simple links (Gallery, Staff), and a 'Book' CTA.

layout_sections.name: Hero & AI Prominence
layout_sections.layout: min-h-[80vh] flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center px-4 relative overflow-hidden. Use a dark luxury interior background image with a heavy bg-black/60 overlay to ensure text contrast.
layout_sections.content: H1 (Playfair, text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight text-white): 'Effortless Beauty, Reimagined.' Subtitle (Outfit, text-muted, text-lg md:text-xl): 'Book your signature look in seconds.'
layout_sections.actions: Two primary buttons side-by-side: 1. 'Book Appointment' (Gold solid button, opens 6-step wizard). 2. 'Let Mira AI Book for You' (Glass button with gold icon/glow, triggers the floating AI widget).

layout_sections.name: 6-Step Booking Wizard (The Core Engine)
layout_sections.layout: Bento-style card in the center of the page (max-w-3xl mx-auto) or a dedicated sticky bottom sheet for mobile. Uses dark surface cards (#141414) with subtle 1px border-white/10.
layout_sections.content: Step indicator (1 to 6) using sleek progress bars. Clean list views for Services and Staff selection. Date/Time uses a customized Shadcn Calendar (dark mode).

layout_sections.name: Staff Registry (Verified Stylists)
layout_sections.layout: Horizontal scroll / Carousel on mobile, 3-column grid on desktop.
layout_sections.content: Stylist cards: Portrait image, Name (Playfair), Title (Outfit), and a glowing 'Verified' badge (Gold/White glass pill with a checkmark icon).

layout_sections.name: Gallery Showcase
layout_sections.layout: Masonry grid or a dense bento grid. gap-4, rounded-xl images. Max height constraints on mobile to prevent infinite scrolling.
layout_sections.content: High-quality salon work (hair models). On hover/tap, slight scale-up. Provide a 'View All' glass button.

layout_sections.name: Refer & Earn Banner
layout_sections.layout: Full-width section with a glassmorphic container (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#D4AF37]/10 border border-[#D4AF37]/30) inside a wrapper with generous padding.
layout_sections.content: Text: 'Share the luxury. Get rewarded.' CTA: 'Get Your Code'. Gold glowing accents.

layout_sections.name: Floating AI Chat Widget (Mira & Owner)
layout_sections.layout: Fixed bottom-right. Prominent glowing orb or elegant glass button.
layout_sections.content: On click, opens a panel with two Tabs (Shadcn Tabs): 'Mira AI' (Voice wave visualizer, chat interface) and 'Owner' (Standard message interface). The widget must pulse softly to invite interaction.

layout_sections.name: Footer
layout_sections.content: Salon Name, Address, Instagram/WhatsApp icons, 'Powered by Miracurl'.

hero_background.description: Contemporary and sophisticated salon interior with stylish lighting

implementation_instructions: Files are .js/.jsx, so use standard React imports and PropTypes if necessary (no TypeScript types).
Tailwind configuration must extend the #0a0a0a background and #D4AF37 primary colors.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for backgrounds; stick to the tinted #0a0a0a (obsidian) for depth.
Headings must use Playfair Display. Install it via Google Fonts if not present.
Body text must use Outfit font.
For the floating AI chat widget, ensure the z-index is maximum (z-[100]) so it sits above the 6-step wizard.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, input fields, and major section wrappers.
